Targeted pass of a 485-page BREF (file GLS_Adopted_03_2012_0.pdf is the 2013 published JRC report; some footers still read 'GLS_Final_Draft March 2012'). Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 24). Main file: melting-furnace SEC by furnace type - FEVE 2005 container survey (Table 3.13, corrected to 50% cullet, NCV fossil + direct electricity) with furnace sizes (Table 3.11); VDI guide values for new furnaces by glass type (Table 3.8, kJ/kg, standardised cullet); energy-balance examples (Table 3.7); flat glass EU range; CFGF, domestic, special (Table 3.34, by furnace type, with CO2), mineral wool, HTIW and frits values; BAT-achievable SEC (Table 4.43) split into one context per sector/size row; plant examples from Tables 4.3, 4.4, 4.17, 4.44, 4.45 and LoNOX; campaign lengths (lifetime) from Chapter 1 and 4; ageing (degradation-rate); thermal efficiency; furnace capex for domestic glass (new furnace per t/d); incremental capex for preheater and LoNOX; levelized melting cost for glass wool oxy; process CO2 180 kg/t from virgin container batch (p.104) and CFGF combustion/process CO2 split. _measures: cullet, batch/cullet preheating (incl. emerging BCP, PRECIOUS), regenerator measures, oxy-fuel conversions and their investment differences, waste heat boilers, fuel and slag. _other-values: size-class splits of Table 3.13, oxy incl. O2 electricity, plant-level inputs/outputs, sector energy, theoretical energy, furnace stock, rebuild and greenfield plant costs, special-glass installation costs, Table 4.18 annualised costs, oxygen supply. Not loaded: BAT-AELs and all non-GHG pollutants, water, noise, dust, abatement-equipment costs (Chapter 8), chart values (Figs 3.2, 3.4, 4.7). Traps: (1) furnace type is often not stated (Table 4.43, domestic, special, CFGF) - those rows use furnace_glass-fuel-fired and are mapped low; (2) Table 3.13 values are cullet-corrected and mix fuel with boost electricity; (3) Table 3.34 has four data columns under three headings (borosilicate tubes split oxy/cross-fired) and Table 4.44 column order was checked on rendered page images; (4) costs carry no price year (text written 2010; publication 2013 used), LoNOX cost is a 1998 estimate; (5) only the FEVE tables state NCV; elsewhere heating-value basis is not stated (EU practice NCV); (6) CFGF CO2 and glass-wool electric SEC are per t finished product, not melt; (7) Table 4.17/4.18/4.44 repeat the same container oxy and glass-ceramics oxy installations - loaded once.
